title: wörds repository index (lingua-index.json)
description: Lists the packs a content repository offers. Index version 1. Readers ignore unknown fields; writers do not add any. A missing required field or a value of the wrong type makes the whole file unreadable; an entry that breaks one of the other rules is skipped.

id.description: The pack's id, equal to "id" in its pack.json. Listed once per index.

path.description: Path of the .linguapack archive, relative to the folder of this index. Plain ASCII segments only.

version.description: The pack's version, equal to "version" in its pack.json.

formatVersion.description: The pack's formatVersion. Apps skip packs with a format they do not support.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the archive file. Checked after the download.

contentTypes.description: The content block types the pack uses, e.g. ["vocabulary"].

title.description: The pack's title, shown before the download. No control characters except line feeds.

sizeBytes.description: Exact size of the archive file in bytes. Checked after the download.

description.description: The pack's description. No control characters except line feeds.
